verdict.rationale: OneDrive's API surface is Microsoft Graph, and Microsoft's first-party Graph Explorer lets users explore Graph APIs and run requests interactively, either anonymously against a sample tenant or against their own or a developer sandbox tenant. That covers the interactive, runnable part of the story, but the evidence never shows the API reference pages themselves embedding runnable examples, nor sample queries specific to drive/driveItem. missing for 10: evidence that the reference docs link to or embed runnable examples, OneDrive/drive-specific sample queries in the explorer, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
